home.hero_eyebrow: Merchant exporter of dehydrated foods · India
home.hero_tagline: India's Harvest, Preserved for the World.
home.hero_sub: We supply food manufacturers, flavour houses and distributors worldwide with premium dehydrated fruit, vegetable, herbal and functional powders — sourced from India's best growing regions.
home.products_heading: Powders and ingredients for every formulation
home.products_sub: From culinary spice blends to functional nutrition — clean-label, food-grade, export-ready.
home.why_dehydrated_sub: Dehydrated ingredients remove up to 95% of moisture — giving buyers a shelf-stable, concentrated raw material that ships efficiently and performs consistently.
home.why_d_shelf_body: 12–24 month shelf life without refrigeration — ideal for global logistics.
home.why_d_light_body: Up to 10× lighter than fresh — lower freight costs per kg of yield.
home.why_d_clean_body: No additives, no preservatives — just dried, milled, sieved ingredient.
home.why_d_colour_body: Vibrant colour retention without synthetic dye — fruit and veg powders used in bakery, snacks and beverages.
home.why_d_flex_body: We work with buyers from 25 kg trial bags to full-container FCL orders.
home.why_d_trace_body: Every batch tied to a sourcing region and crop cycle — spec sheets on request.
home.industries_sub: We supply dehydrated ingredients to businesses that build flavour into their products:
home.industries_body: Our role is to support these industries with reliable, food-grade ingredients that add real value to their end products.
home.edge_sub: We're a lean, focused operation — built around one thing: making it easy for international buyers to source quality dehydrated ingredients from India.
home.edge_trace_body: Every shipment carries full batch documentation — origin, processing date, lab results.
home.edge_integrity_body: No hidden costs, no middlemen surprises — clear specs, clear pricing, clear timelines.
home.edge_partner_body: We grow with our buyers. Repeat customers get priority allocation, flexible payment terms and dedicated support.
home.edge_custom_body: Mesh size, moisture level, bulk density — we match your spec sheet, not the other way round.
home.edge_docs_body: COA, MSDS, phytosanitary, fumigation and halal certificates handled as standard.
home.edge_responsive_body: Real responses within 24 hours — sample requests, spec clarifications and re-orders handled fast.
home.quality_sub: Every lot is tested for moisture, microbial load, and physical parameters before dispatch — we don't ship product that hasn't cleared QC.
home.markets_sub: We currently export to 15+ countries across Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and beyond.
home.working_sub: From first enquiry to shipment at your port — a process built for international buyers.
home.working_step1_body: Tell us the product, quantity, grade and destination. We respond within 24 hours.
home.working_step2_body: Clear pricing with Incoterm, packaging specs and lead time — no hidden fees.
home.working_step3_body: We ship a lab-tested sample before you commit to the full order.
home.working_step4_body: Sign off on the PI. We begin production or allocation from our inventory.
home.working_step5_body: Batch re-tested. COA and full export documentation prepared.
home.working_step6_body: Goods loaded, BL issued, documents couriered or sent digitally.
home.certs_sub: Our registrations and partner facility certifications ensure your product clears customs and meets buyer requirements worldwide.
home.cta_sub: Send us your product requirement and we'll come back with specs, pricing and a sample offer — usually within 24 hours.
about.hero_heading: Bringing India's harvest to the world's food businesses
about.hero_sub: Clarté Overseas is a New Delhi-based merchant exporter. We source, quality-check and ship dehydrated fruits, vegetables, herbal and functional powders to food manufacturers and distributors worldwide.
about.who_body1: We started Clarté Overseas because sourcing from India shouldn't be complicated. The country produces outstanding dehydrated ingredients — onion, garlic, ginger, moringa, beetroot, mango and dozens more — but the export process has historically been fragmented: too many intermediaries, inconsistent quality, and documentation that varies supplier to supplier.
about.who_body2: Our job is to change that. We act as a single, accountable point of contact between India's ingredient producers and your procurement team. Every order comes with clear specs, traceable batches and the export documentation you need to clear customs.
about.purpose_heading: Building the world's go-to ingredient partner
about.mission_body: To make sourcing dehydrated food ingredients from India as straightforward and trustworthy as sourcing from any established food-exporting nation — with full traceability, consistent quality and honest pricing.
about.vision_body: To become the first-choice Indian ingredient partner for food businesses across Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific — recognised for reliability as much as quality.
about.goal1: Certified to international standards across our product range
about.goal2: Dedicated quality lab and in-house testing
about.goal3: Private label and contract packing capability
about.goal4: Direct relationships with growers across key Indian growing regions
about.values_sub: The way we like to work
about.val1_body: We share specs, batch documents and pricing without you having to chase us.
about.val2_body: We'd rather lose a deal than ship product that doesn't meet your requirements.
about.val3_body: We don't optimise for the first order. We optimise for a 10-year relationship.
about.val4_body: Small team means fast decisions — you talk to the people who make the calls.
about.val5_body: We're proud of Indian produce. We represent it honestly, without overpromising.
about.val6_body: Every shipment teaches us something. We document it and get better.
about.partner1_body: Looking for a reliable Indian supplier for your existing customer base? We offer consistent quality, competitive pricing and full documentation.
about.partner2_body: Need a specific dehydrated ingredient to spec? We work to your technical sheet — moisture, mesh, microbial limits and all.
about.partner3_body: We can pack under your brand, in your specified packaging format, with compliant labelling.
about.partner4_body: If you represent buyers in your market, we're open to agency and commission arrangements.
about.partner5_body: Have a custom blend or proprietary formulation? We work with certified facilities to produce to your recipe.
about.cta_sub: Whether you're an importer looking for a new Indian supplier or a manufacturer needing a specific ingredient, we'd like to hear from you.
export.hero_heading: How your order travels from India to your port
export.hero_sub: A clear, step-by-step view of how we handle every shipment — from the moment you confirm an order to the day it arrives at your destination port.
export.step1_body: You approve the proforma invoice and pay the agreed advance. We raise the purchase order to our processing partner.
export.step2_body: Product is processed or allocated from stock. Internal QC checks moisture, mesh, colour and microbial load.
export.step3_body: Final batch is re-tested. COA, MSDS and any buyer-specific certificates are prepared.
export.step4_body: Goods are packed to your spec — kraft bags, HDPE drums, vacuum pouches or bulk sacks. Labels carry batch number, best-before and origin.
export.step5_body: We handle Indian customs clearance. Export documents include: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate and fumigation certificate where required.
export.step6_body: Cargo is loaded at an Indian port (typically JNPT, Chennai or Mundra). BL is issued on departure.
export.step7_body: Documents are couriered or sent digitally. We track the shipment and send updates at key milestones.
export.incoterms_sub: We support four standard delivery terms. Pick the one that fits your logistics setup.
export.cta_sub: Send us your product list and destination. We'll come back with a shipping quote and lead time within 24 hours.
cert.hero_heading: Credentials you can open, read and verify
cert.hero_sub: Every document listed here is real, current and available on request. We don't list certifications we don't hold.
cert.partner_heading: Standards held by our partner facilities
cert.partner_sub: We work with processing facilities that hold internationally recognised certifications. These apply to the manufacturing and processing of the products we source.
cert.cta_sub: Have a specific certification requirement? Tell us what your buyer or regulator needs and we'll confirm what we can provide.
contact.hero_sub: Whether you have a specific product in mind or just want to explore what we can supply, we're here to help.
contact.talk_sub: Reach us however suits you. We typically respond within a few hours during business hours.
contact.success_body: We've received your enquiry and will get back to you within 24 hours.
